pages.text: $(thing)Flue curing$() uses controlled heat without putting the rack directly over smoke. It takes $(item)36,000 ticks$(), about $(item)1.5 Minecraft days$().

pages.title: Flue Firebox
pages.text: A lit Flue Firebox supplies the heat source used by nearby racks.

pages.title: Hanging Bunches
pages.text: Hanging bunches can also Flue Cure from nearby lit Flue Fireboxes. Direct fire or smoke contamination still disqualifies clean flue curing; the bunch itself is already considered covered because it must be attached beneath a support.

A flue rack must:$(br2)- not be rained on$(br)- have no direct sky access$(br)- have 2 air blocks immediately above it$(br)- have a sturdy roof underside 3–5 blocks above$(br)- have no nearby fire/campfire contamination$(br)- have at least 1 lit Flue Firebox nearby
pages.title: Rack Requirements

pages.text: The Firebox must be at the rack's Y level or one block lower, and within horizontal Manhattan distance $(item)3$(). In simple terms, count north/south/east/west steps from rack to firebox; the total must be 3 or less.
pages.title: Firebox Range

pages.text: Any normal fire, soul fire, campfire, or soul campfire within the 3×3×3 area centered around the rack blocks flue curing. Flue curing requires indirect heat without direct smoke contamination.
pages.title: No Smoke Contamination
